title: The Sleeping Giant's Snores
story: Snorbold the Giant has fallen asleep right on top of the only tunnel out of the valley! He snores a great rumbling snore every 5 seconds, and Mr 6 can only tiptoe forward while a snore covers the sound of his clanking armor. The tunnel takes 20 seconds to cross.
question: How many snores will Mr 6 need to sneak all the way through?
hint: Count by 5s until you reach 20: 5, 10, 15... How many numbers did you say?
victory: On the fourth mighty snore, Mr 6 slips out the far side of the tunnel. Snorbold snorts, rolls over, and never even knew a knight tiptoed by!
solution: Each snore lets Mr 6 sneak 5 feet, and he needs to cross 20 feet.
Count by 5s to 20: 5, 10, 15, 20 - that's 4 counts, or 20 ÷ 5 = 4.
praise: Skip-counting by 5s was a smart move - the last step was counting how many 5s you said, not the number you landed on. Great thinking!
